entries.4e60e419ee0d0b77: It is a holding company with Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation and Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation as its directly held subsidiaries, and the group consists of 350 subsidiaries and 139 affiliates and other companies. It manufactures and sells specialty materials such as films, high-performance resins and materials for semiconductors; basic petrochemical materials such as ethylene and polyolefins; MMA, which is a raw material for acrylic resins; and industrial gases such as oxygen and nitrogen. The company sets as its Purpose “to lead the realization of KAITEKI, in which the comfort of people, society and the planet continues, through innovative solutions,” and states its desired state for 2035 as a “‘Green Specialty’ company that inspires customers through the power of materials.” In July 2025, it transferred its consolidated subsidiary Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation and exited the pharmaceuticals business.

entries.5c0b6d68bb8a7de6: Profit before income taxes for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥711 million, which is also the amount for continuing operations. Profit attributable to owners of the parent of ¥11,829 million includes profit from discontinued operations of ¥94,780 million, which includes the profit from the sale of Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma.
